title: A Blood Glucose Control Framework Based on Reinforcement Learning With Safety and Interpretability: In Silico Validation
evidence_anchors: Methods Sec. III, Figs. 1–2, Algorithms 1–3; Experiments Sec. IV-A–C, Tables 1–2, Figs. 3–4; Appendix A.
reviewer_notes: Closed-loop simulator utility and safety are strong, but learned dynamics have only a fixed 30-minute error test; no calibration, action ablation, external validation, or public artifacts.

title: A data-driven Alzheimer's disease progression simulator for retrospective validation and prospective Phase III power design.
evidence_anchors: Abstract; Methods pp. 6–16 and Algorithm 1; Results/trial figures pp. 17–27; code/data statements.
reviewer_notes: Six placebo/treatment profiles and power simulations support action evidence. External RCT comparison is adapted with trial-specific calibration, so it is not frozen; safety and full causal identification remain absent.

title: Autosomal Dominant Tubulointerstitial Kidney Disease Clinical Trial Simulator: Case Reports of Model-Informed Drug Development.
evidence_anchors: Model/Methods and Fig. 1; case studies and Figs./Tables 2–5; Discussion and Data S1.
reviewer_notes: Placebo plus parameter-effect scenarios support action testing and trial utility, but treatment effects are imposed rather than empirically validated; external, causal, safety, and calibration evidence are absent.

title: Control of Magnetic Surgical Robots With Model-Based Simulators and Reinforcement Learning.
evidence_anchors: Methods Sec. IV-B.1–5; Experiments Sec. V-A–D; Tables I–II and Figs. 4–6.
reviewer_notes: Real closed-loop transfer is demonstrated on the same apparatus that supplied training data. Physical hazards are discussed/managed, but no independent device, uncertainty, horizon-fidelity, or public implementation is provided.

title: Development of a model-based clinical trial simulation platform to optimize the design of clinical trials for Duchenne muscular dystrophy.
evidence_anchors: Methods and Tables 1–3; development/external VPC Figs. 1–5 and supplement; Appendix S5.
reviewer_notes: Frozen non-US natural-history validation is strong. Hypothetical treatment perturbations have no observed treatment-effect or causal validation; VPC intervals are uncertainty evidence but not formal calibration coverage.

title: Generating whole-brain neural activity and behavior through unified latent dynamics
evidence_anchors: Results Secs. 2.2–2.5, Figs. 2–4; Methods Secs. 4.1–4.5; Fig. S1.
reviewer_notes: Long stochastic rollouts and synthetic steering are well characterized, but all empirical evaluation uses one training recording and latent interventions lack biological, causal, external, or safety validation.

title: Machine Learning for Mechanical Ventilation Control
evidence_anchors: Methods pp. 5–8, Secs. 3–5, Figs. 3–9; Fig. 5 for 25-step error; Appendix B, Tables 3–5.
reviewer_notes: Horizon-resolved simulator error and real hardware control with explicit safeguards are strengths. Transfer remains on the same platform, and uncertainty, action-agnostic comparison, patient evidence, and learned artifacts are absent.

title: OMG-RL:Offline Model-based Guided Reward Learning for Heparin Treatment
evidence_anchors: Methods pp. 5–7, Algorithms 1–2; Setup pp. 7–8; Results pp. 8–13, Figs. 2–8; limitations p. 13.
reviewer_notes: Policy value is evaluated with WIS and model rollouts, but direct dynamics fidelity, action support, confounding, calibration, external validation, and explicit bleeding/thrombosis hazard tests are missing.

title: SimulAD: a dynamical model for personalized simulation and disease staging in Alzheimer's disease.
evidence_anchors: Secs. 2.1–2.6 and Tables 1–2; Figs. 3–6 and Table 4; Discussion/Conclusion pp. 80–82.
reviewer_notes: The paper repeats a treatment-impact capability claim, so the highest claim is counterfactual, but the empirical study tests only staging/natural-history prediction. GMC is independent yet adapted through imputation/harmonization and GMC-specific fitting.

title: The Coupled Stochastic Dynamical System: A Generative Model for Simulating and Forecasting Youth Mental Health Trajectories
evidence_anchors: Abstract; Methods Secs. 2.1–2.7 pp. 5–15; Results Tables 3–4/Figs. 3–5 pp. 16–20; Discussion pp. 20–25.
reviewer_notes: Counterfactual/intervention capability is claimed, but reported tests are passive generation and rolling forecasts. Forecasts are horizon-resolved with calibration plots; no action perturbation, causal estimand, external cohort, prospective utility, or current public code.
